name: Re-shoot
summary: Moves the camera to a new angle on an existing clip (MiniMax H3 + MoGe + CrossView).

source.notes: Comfy's own reference app, shown on a 96 GB GPU. Runs on a 48 GB L40S in Modal: 196.2 s (20261020-133620-l40s) and 222.9 s (20261024-035222-l40s) for a 4 s clip, peak 44.2 GB (the text encoder alone is 27.1 GB). The second output, "Warp guide", is the clip reprojected to the new angle with its holes in magenta: what MiniMax H3 fills in. The first pass is fixed at 0.5 MP (the CrossView-Warp LoRA was trained at 512×512 × 73 frames; its examples start at 0.5 MP). "Refine" switches in the second pass of the LoRA author's workflow (Cseti/ComfyUI-Workflows, minimax-h3/crossview-warp): 1.5 MP, 10 steps, 0.3 denoise, rebuilt from core nodes by tools/build_apps.py (reshoot_two_pass).

inputs.label: Your clip
inputs.help: 5 to 15 seconds, one clear subject near the middle of the frame, an uncluttered scene. 16:9 matches the LoRA's examples.

inputs.label: Orbit (degrees)
inputs.help: Most reliable within 45 degrees either way; the training set reaches 90. Avoid 0 with Height at 0: the LoRA misbehaves when the new view is nearly the source.

inputs.label: Height (degrees)
inputs.help: Most reliable from -20 to 30; the training set covers -35 to 45.

inputs.label: Distance
inputs.help: Leave at 1 unless you are experimenting: the node's author says distance is not followed reliably.

inputs.label: Refine to 1.5 MP (second pass)
inputs.help: Off: one pass at 0.5 MP, the size the LoRA's examples start from. On: the LoRA author's second pass scales that result to 1.5 MP and refines it (10 steps at 0.3 denoise); slower.

inputs.label: Seconds to keep
inputs.help: Snapped to a frame count the model accepts. The LoRA was trained on 3-second clips (73 frames); its examples use 5 seconds (124 frames).

inputs.label: Extra description (optional)
inputs.help: The trigger word is added for you. Describe what should appear in the areas the original camera never saw (magenta in the Warp guide).

models.license: Not stated on the model card (its code, ModelTC/Minimax-H3-Turbo, is Apache-2.0)
